test_title: PYST 09: SSC Stenographer 2025: General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Criteria to be selected as Lab Assistant (as on 01-03-2024):

Must have a Diploma in Lab Technology with at least 60% marks.

Age must be 21 to 28 years.

Should have minimum 1 year practical lab experience.

Must be willing to work in night shifts.

Special Clause:

If the candidate has 70% in Diploma but only 6 months of experience, refer to Chief Lab Supervisor.

Case:

Irfan is 22 years old, has 72% in Lab Diploma, 6 months of experience, and agrees to night shifts.

Question: What should be done in Irfan's case?
solution:
Criteria to be selected as Field Officer (as on 01-01-2024) are as follows:

 
 

 Eligibility criteria
 Fulfillment
 
 

 Must have a Diploma in Lab Technology with at least 60% marks.
 Yes, Irfan has 72% in Lab Diploma
 
 

 Age must be 21 to 28 years.
 Yes, Irfan is 22 years old
 
 

 Should have minimum 1 year practical lab experience.
 No, Irfan has 6 months of experience.
 
 

 Must be willing to work in night shifts.
 Yes, Irfan agrees to night shifts.
 
 

 If the candidate has 70% in Diploma but only 6 months of experience, refer to Chief Lab Supervisor.
 Applicable
 
 

Thus, Irfan will be referred to the Chief Lab Supervisor.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
